rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for shattering someone's illusion or false belief.

example.english: His betrayal helped to disillusion me about love.
example.traditional: 佢嘅背叛打破幻想，令我唔再相信愛情。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ge3 bui3 bun6 daa2 po3 waan6 soeng2 ling6 ngo5 m4 zoi3 soeng1 seon3 oi3 cing4

rows.jyutping: ling6 A jan6 cing1 jin6 sat6
rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is making someone face and understand reality rather than simply shattering an illusion.

example.english: Getting fired helped to disillusion me about the job market.
example.traditional: 嗰次炒魷魚令我認清現實。
example.jyutping: go2 ci3 caau2 jau4 jyu4 ling6 ngo5 jan6 cing1 jin6 sat6
